about_the_game:
F-Drones Simulator is a combat FPV drone simulator that delivers the most authentic experience of flying and striking targets. Step into the world of drone warfare, where everything comes down to precision, a cool head, and seconds. Fly a combat drone in first person and destroy enemy equipment on the battlefield.

Key features:

  • Realistic flight physics. The simulator reproduces the behavior of real F-Drones airframes: inertia, thrust drop-off, and handling at the edge of control. Combined with radio horizon effects, EW (electronic warfare) interference, and an honest battery discharge model, it gives you the full picture of a combat sortie.

  • Pro-level drone tuning. Rates and other parameters work exactly like a real configurator. Experienced pilots dial the airframe in to their own flying style; newcomers learn what each parameter actually changes.

  • Flexible OSD. Customize your on-screen display: battery level, altitude, speed, signal strength, and other readouts. See exactly what you need — and nothing more.

  • Large maps on real terrain. Locations are built from real elevation data — different terrain, different conditions, a different challenge on every approach to the target.

  • Varied combat missions. Scenarios with unique objectives that test both your piloting technique and your tactical thinking.

  • A strike arsenal. Choose munitions and explosive payloads to match the target and get the job done.

F-Drones Simulator stands apart through its attention to detail and personalized approach — from your first hover to complex combat missions. It's a trainer where the skills you build carry weight beyond the game.
